description: Grok Build coding agent for VS Code. Sign in with your browser, then chat, edit, and run tools in the sidebar.

config.title: Grok Build
config.cliPath: Absolute path to the grok binary. Empty means auto-detect (PATH, then ~/.grok/bin).
config.preferWorkspaceBinary: When this repo has been built, prefer target/release/xai-grok-pager over the installed grok CLI.
config.minCliVersion: Minimum grok CLI version required by the extension.
config.permissionMode: ask: prompt before file writes and shell. acceptEdits: allow file edits, still ask for shell. auto: approve Allow once.
config.permissionMode.ask: Prompt before file writes and shell commands.
config.permissionMode.acceptEdits: Allow file edits without prompting. Still ask for shell and other tools.
config.includeSelectionOnSend: When the editor has a selection, attach it to the next prompt.
config.alwaysApprove: Skip tool permission prompts on new and loaded sessions. Does not require restarting the agent.
config.notifySound: Play a sound when a turn finishes or is interrupted.
config.locale: Language for the Grok sidebar. auto follows the VS Code display language.
